about.title: 关于我
about.bio: 我目前是武汉大学网络空间安全学院的博士研究生，师从 曹越 教授。我的研究聚焦于工业控制系统（ICS）与工业物联网（IIoT）环境下的安全问题，涵盖密码协议设计、零信任认证架构、以及隐私保护数据共享等方向。在攻读博士期间，参与了多项国家级科研项目，并在相关领域发表多篇学术论文。

education.degree: 博士研究生 · 网络空间安全

research.title: 研究方向
research.description: 我的研究围绕工业互联网安全展开，重点关注以下方向：

areas.name: 工业控制网络安全
areas.description: 研究工业控制系统（ICS/SCADA）的安全威胁检测与防御机制，包括协议安全分析、入侵检测系统设计、以及工控蜜罐技术。

areas.name: 工业物联网安全
areas.description: 面向工业物联网（IIoT）场景，研究设备身份认证、固件安全分析、边缘计算安全等关键技术。

areas.name: 密码协议
areas.description: 设计与分析适用于资源受限环境的高效密码协议，包括认证密钥协商、属性基加密、以及后量子密码算法在工控场景中的应用。

areas.name: 零信任认证
areas.description: 研究零信任架构下的持续身份验证与动态访问控制机制，构建面向工业场景的细粒度授权框架。

areas.name: 安全数据共享
areas.description: 研究跨域数据安全共享中的隐私保护与访问控制问题，设计兼顾安全性与可用性的数据共享方案。

areas.name: 隐私保护计算
areas.description: 探索联邦学习、安全多方计算、差分隐私等技术在工业数据协作中的应用，解决数据可用不可见的关键挑战。

about.title: About Me
about.bio: I am currently a Ph.D. student at the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University. My research focuses on security issues in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), including cryptographic protocol design, zero-trust authentication architectures, and privacy-preserving data sharing. During my doctoral studies, I have participated in several national-level research projects and published multiple papers in related fields.
researchInterests: Design and Analysis of Cryptographic Protocols

research.title: Research Directions
research.description: My research revolves around industrial Internet security, focusing on the following areas:

areas.name: Industrial Control Network Security
areas.description: Research on threat detection and defense mechanisms for Industrial Control Systems (ICS/SCADA), including protocol security analysis, intrusion detection system design, and ICS honeypot technologies.

areas.name: Industrial IoT Security
areas.description: Focused on Industrial IoT (IIoT) scenarios, investigating device identity authentication, firmware security analysis, and edge computing security key technologies.

areas.name: Cryptographic Protocols
areas.description: Design and analysis of efficient cryptographic protocols for resource-constrained environments, including authenticated key agreement, attribute-based encryption, and post-quantum cryptographic algorithms in ICS scenarios.

areas.name: Zero-Trust Authentication
areas.description: Research on continuous identity verification and dynamic access control mechanisms under zero-trust architecture, building fine-grained authorization frameworks for industrial scenarios.

areas.name: Secure Data Sharing
areas.description: Investigating privacy protection and access control issues in cross-domain secure data sharing, designing solutions that balance security and usability.

areas.name: Privacy-Preserving Computing
areas.description: Exploring the application of federated learning, secure multi-party computation, and differential privacy in industrial data collaboration, addressing the key challenge of making data usable without exposure.
